links.comparator_used: Original CIRSE interventional radiology procedure descriptions, left unsimplified
links.outcome: Readability (FRE, Gunning Fog, ARI) improved, but DISCERN credibility and reliability score fell
links.effect: FRE 47.2 to 78.4; GF 14.4 to 7.8; ARI 11.2 to 5.8 (p < 0.001); mean DISCERN 3.73 to 2.99 (p < 0.001); 73 procedures
links.tradeoff: Reliability and credibility (DISCERN) decreased after ChatGPT simplification, so human review and prompt engineering are suggested.
links.quote: The original FRE score was 47.2 (Difficult), improved to 78.4 (Fairly Easy) by ChatGPT.
